title: Binance Will Add Simon's Cat (1000CAT) and Pudgy Penguins (PENGU) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Simon's Cat (1000CAT) and Pudgy Penguins (PENGU)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin ,  Binance Auto-Invest , and  Binance Futures  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn Simon's Cat (1000CAT)  and  Pudgy Penguins (PENGU)  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn Flexible Products at  2024-12-17 09:00 (UTC)  and  2024-12-17 14:00 (UTC) respectively  and will be  available for subscription . From  2024-12-18 10:00 (UTC) , users may purchase  1000CAT  and  PENGU  using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  1000CAT  and  PENGU  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay,  or buy and sell  1000CAT  and  PENGU  with their  wallet balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  1000CAT  and  PENGU  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading  1000CAT  and  PENGU  against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of  1000CAT  and  PENGU  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add  1000CAT  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  1000CAT/USDT  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-12-17 11:00 (UTC)  . Binance Margin will add  PENGU  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  PENGU/USDT  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-12-17 16:30 (UTC). Binance VIP 7 to VIP 9 users will be able to borrow the abovementioned asset(s) on Cross Margin approximately 30 minutes before it is open for Margin trading.  Note:  Interest is charged on these loans even though margin trading for these tokens has not commenced. Please note that newly listed tokens tend to be volatile; users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies when trading such tokens. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will launch the  USDⓈ-M PENGU Perpetual Contract  at  2024-12-17 16:15 (UTC) , with up to 75x leverage.  More details on the  USDⓈ-M PENGU Perpetual Contracts  can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract PENGUUSDT Launch Time  2024-12-17 16:15 (UTC) Underlying Asset Pudgy Penguins (PENGU) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.000001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 75x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the PENGUUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2024-12-17 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-12-18 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-12-18 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-12-18 08:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the PENGUUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the PENGUUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the PENGUUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The PENGUUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
